cases.name: A'Miyah La'Shay Hughes
cases.narrative:
On 7/30/2022, her body was found, along with her two sisters, in a pond near Hwy 77. Police focused their search around the pond after a pair of shoes and other items of clothing were found scattered near and in the water.

“Initially, I was told that they had drowned — an accidental drowning. But after [the] autopsy report came out, I was told that they were strangled, they had lacerations to their faces and they were also sexually assaulted,” said (their mother Shommaonique Oliver)-Wickerson, who suffered a heart attack and had to be rushed to the hospital. However, in a press release shared three weeks after “RBN’s” call, the DA’s office reportedly said the preliminary autopsy report stated homicide was the cause of death. Both Wickerson and “RBN” had their requests for a copy of that autopsy denied, with the latter being told it was due to it being an ongoing investigation involving minors.
